title: Dominie
html_source:
Scottish slang for teacher (Gifford).

Dominie originates from the Latin word Dominus. The Pocket Oxford Latin Dictionary (1994) gives the following definitions for dominus:

Master of the house
Owner
Lord, ruler
Host

anchor.prefix: ends of his legs, nebeneinander. Sounds solid: made by the mallet of Los Demiurgos. Am I walking into eternity along Sandymount strand? Crush, crack, crick, crick. Wild sea money.
